instruction.text: Complete the sentence by writing the correct spelling of the word in the gap.

atoms.b: The biscuits are so delicious that I keep eating them, even ((though)) I’m already full.
atoms.finishSound: The biscuits are so delicious that I keep eating them, even though I’m already full.

atoms.b: We are moving, so we will have a new ((address)).
atoms.finishSound: We are moving, so we will have a new address.

atoms.b: I cannot ((believe)) how beautiful it is here.
atoms.finishSound: I cannot believe how beautiful it is here.

atoms.b: I would like a new ((bicycle)) for my birthday.
atoms.finishSound: I would like a new bicycle for my birthday.

atoms.b: At the turn of the last ((century)), we also started a new millennium.
atoms.finishSound: At the turn of the last century, we also started a new millennium.
